description: This file is a shell script for testing the behavior of Perforce (p4) integrated with Git, focusing on file locking scenarios and various file operations such as editing, deleting, copying, and moving within a Perforce environment.

methods.name: lock_in_another_client
methods.description: Creates a second Perforce client, syncs the depot, and opens a file for editing in that client to simulate a lock being taken by another user.
